proof.code: Initial non-routine state appends the Load selection button

conclusions: The form interaction repair is reached successfully: Word, year and title are selected before the real Generate Report button is clicked.
The existing region locator exactly matches the actual named section constructed by createReviewPreparationView; no renamed accessible interface is evidenced.
All four snapshots show the original Budget Overview and filled Reports form after the click, with no preparation region and no Load selection button.
This is an observed failure to reach or mount the preparation view; the supplied artifacts do not identify whether submit handling, navigation or a script exception caused it.
No alternative entry link is substituted: doing so would bypass the required Generate Report entry being qualified.

coordination.scope: Trace mounted submit bridge/router/bootstrap and supply a causal product/shared patch if justified.
coordination.sent: Exact workspace blob/interface and snapshot observations supplied to producer_contract and root.

limits: No PASS, no timeout increase, no direct HTTP bypass, no grant synthesis and no claim that the existing preparation module is absent from composition.
